name: Emerge
tagline: Twenty five years of satellite fire data as one fire calendar, for any place on Earth.
lookNote: Three looks are kept side by side until the team picks one.
reportPlaceholder: The fire report for this place is built by another part of the team and appears here.
disclaimerShort: Research prototype. Not an official warning. Follow local authorities (112 in the EU, 911 in the US).
toolDrawHint: Click the corners, then the first corner again to close the area.
toolRadius: Search distance for a clicked point
toolRadiusHint: Click the map to pick a point. Fires within this distance count.
howWeKnow: How we know it is right
countryHint: Click the map to pick a point, or search for a country above.
creditBasemap: Base map imagery: NASA Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA ESDIS
creditDrivers: Soil moisture, plant greenness, land type and air temperature: NASA SMAP, VIIRS, MODIS and AIRS through NASA GIBS; NASA fire-weather index: NASA GEOS-5 through Copernicus GWIS
creditForecastWeather: Point weather in the forecast panel: Open-Meteo.com
creditSearch: Place search: Photon, with data from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
timelineFixed: The slider moves fire history and fire danger. These show their latest observation instead: {layers}.
